SELECT FROM TBL_RISK_MONITORING_RECORDS r
ORDER BY r.CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_RISK_MONITORING_RECORDS r WHERE r.RISKTYPEID = #{riskTypeId} ORDER BY r.CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_RISK_MONITORING_RECORDS r WHERE r.RISKSTATUS = #{riskStatus} ORDER BY r.CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_RISK_MONITORING_RECORDS r WHERE r.RISKSTATUS IN ('CRITICAL', 'BREACH') ORDER BY r.CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_RISK_MONITORING_RECORDS r WHERE r.ALERTTRIGGERED = 1 ORDER BY r.CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_RISK_MONITORING_RECORDS r WHERE (r.RISKSTATUS IN ('CRITICAL', 'BREACH') OR r.ACTIONREQUIRED = 'ESCALATE') ORDER BY r.CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_RISK_MONITORING_RECORDS r WHERE r.ASSESSMENTID = #{assessmentId} ORDER BY r.CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_RISK_MONITORING_RECORDS r WHERE r.MONITORINGUSER = #{monitoringUser} ORDER BY r.CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_RISK_MONITORING_RECORDS r WHERE r.MONITORINGDATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY r.CREATETIME DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.RISKSTATUS = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 END) as normalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.RISKSTATUS = 'WARNING' THEN 1 END) as warningCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.RISKSTATUS = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 END) as criticalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.RISKSTATUS = 'BREACH' THEN 1 END) as breachCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.ALERTTRIGGERED = 1 THEN 1 END) as alertCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.ACTIONREQUIRED = 'ESCALATE' THEN 1 END) as escalateCount FROM TBL_RISK_MONITORING_RECORDS r WHERE r.ORGID = #{orgid}

SELECT TO_CHAR(r.MONITORINGDATE, 'YYYY-MM') as month, COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.RISKSTATUS IN ('CRITICAL', 'BREACH') THEN 1 END) as highRiskCount, AVG(r.CURRENTRISKVALUE) as avgRiskValue FROM TBL_RISK_MONITORING_RECORDS r WHERE r.MONITORINGDATE >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -12) AND r.ORGID = #{orgid} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(r.MONITORINGDATE, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY month DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_RISK_MONITORING_RECORDS r WHERE r.NEXTMONITORINGDATE < SYSDATE AND r.RISKSTATUS != 'NORMAL' AND r.ORGID = #{orgid} ORDER BY r.NEXTMONITORINGDATE ASC
